description_en: Queries the status and result of a C2PA content credential signing task
description_zh: 查询C2PA内容凭证签名任务的状态和结果
name: GetC2paSignResult

parameters.help_en: The opaque task ID returned by `CreateC2paSignTask`. Maximum length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: `CreateC2paSignTask` 返回的不透明任务 ID，最多 64 个字符
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The business error code of this API call. The value `OK` is returned when the call succeeds
Code.description_zh: 本次接口调用的业务错误码。调用成功时返回 `OK`

ErrorCode.description_en: The task error code. This parameter is returned only when `Status=FAILED`
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务失败错误码，仅在 `Status=FAILED` 时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The task error message. This parameter is returned only when `Status=FAILED`
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败错误信息，仅在 `Status=FAILED` 时返回
ErrorMessage.example: only valid JPEG and PNG source files are supported
ErrorMessage.title_zh: 任务错误信息，仅FAILED时返回

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned when the call succeeds
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。接口调用成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned when the call succeeds
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。接口调用成功时返回 `success`

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 调用的请求 ID

SignedFileUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the signature file. This parameter is returned only when `Status=SUCCEEDED`
SignedFileUrl.description_zh: 签名文件的临时下载地址，仅在 `Status=SUCCEEDED` 时返回
SignedFileUrl.title_zh: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，仅成功时返回

Status.title_zh: 任务状态：PROCESSING、SUCCEEDED 或 FAILED。FAILED 为终态，系统不会自动重试、重新入队或重签；C2pa.SigningOutcomeUnconfirmed 表示可能已有DigiCert副作用，需人工核实

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the query call is successful. This value can still be `true` even if the task itself failed
Success.description_zh: 表示本次查询调用是否成功。任务本身失败时，该值仍可能为 `true`

TaskId.title_zh: CA/DigiCert异步签名任务ID，不属于原SignUserImage
